dedupe_keys.name: safetycube european road safety decision support system

description: The European Road Safety Decision Support System was developed by the SafetyCube (Safety CaUsation, Benefits and Efficiency) project, funded by the European Commission under Horizon 2020 from May 2015 for three years (grant 633485). It is a web knowledge base meant to help policy makers and stakeholders select and implement the most appropriate and cost-effective strategies and measures to reduce casualties for all road users and severities in Europe and worldwide. The site offers searchable knowledge on road safety risk factors and measures, a calculator for costs and benefits of measures and a description of the methodology, and the project also documented the data sources it used and an interactive stakeholder platform. Coverage is Europe, with worldwide evidence. Access: free to use online; contact is through Loughborough University, and no data licence is named on the home page read. Caveats: the project ended in 2018, so the evidence base may not have been updated since, and content is synthesised from studies, not raw data. It supports road safety investment appraisal, the choice of measures in road network risk studies and cost-benefit analysis of safety programmes, and complements the national road accident records catalogued here.
